Abstract: The mechanistic interactions responsible for the successful production of broadly neutralizing <m>antibodies</m> in response to <m>antigenic</m> challenge take place inside <m>germinal</m> <m>centers</m> where the seeding <m>B</m>-<m>cells</m> undergo proliferation and <m>somatic</m> <m>hypermutation</m> in the presence of <m>antigen</m> and <m>T</m> <m>follicular</m> <m>helper</m> <m>cells</m>.
